structural_finding.hf_research_target: future mid-price markout and fill-conditioned adverse selection at seconds-to-minutes horizons
structural_finding.coherent_binary_book_result: with complement-mirrored YES/NO books, the incumbent micro fair equals the YES microprice and remains inside the spread, so taker gross edge is non-positive before fees and slippage
structural_finding.interpretation: positive incumbent micro entries require cross-side parity/asymmetry or book incoherence; that is not the same object as directional short-horizon microstructure alpha

first_live_event_time_evaluation.cost_model: half-spread plus 2 bps configured slippage; protocol taker fee excluded
first_live_event_time_evaluation.economic_interpretation: the current single-window taker challenger is rejected: every evaluated horizon has negative mean net markout at every cost stress, even before adding protocol taker fees
first_live_event_time_evaluation.statistical_interpretation: the multifeature ridge only marginally improves MSE at 1s/5s and materially worsens it at 30s/60s; one window cannot establish absence of all HF alpha

methodology_defect_and_fix.defect: the first purged evaluator ordered predictor rows and future targets by exchange timestamp; variable feed latency can reorder messages, allowing an exchange-time future update that was already received before the predictor row to contaminate decision-time chronology
methodology_defect_and_fix.correct_decision_clock: received_ts_ms when available; exchange_ts_ms retained for feed-latency measurement
methodology_defect_and_fix.rule: do not treat the exact pre-fix markout statistics as final causal estimates until the receive-time rerun completes

aggressive_micro_forecast_warning.reason: the proposed extrapolative micro forecast uses contemporaneous microprice displacement and depth imbalance with fixed multipliers; the first live causal challenger using richer microprice/imbalance/OFI/spread/latency features is cost-negative at all tested horizons and stress levels, so current HF evidence does not justify interpreting the aggressive forecast as validated short-horizon alpha

forward_maker_context.transfer_rule: do not transfer this fill rate to B2 or to the V5 micro sleeve

next_required_live_dataset.unit: market-event-time snapshot ordered on local receive time
next_required_live_dataset.comparison: microprice-displacement baseline versus causal microprice+imbalance+OFI+spread+latency model on identical chronological rows
